events.title: The Demo Is Now Available!
events.summary: The Demo Is Now Available! We have some great news for everyone reading this announcement: the demo for Recycle Shop ECO is now live! In the demo, you can play through a large portion of the puzzle gameplay, the first episode of each character's story, and some of the casual conversations. Please Take Our Content Survey We're also collecting feedback on the demo through a short survey.
